_comment: Definition lock for scripts/check_definition_drift.py. Generated, never hand-edited. Regenerate with --update; the resulting diff IS the definition-change alert. Unlike the *_baseline.json ratchets this tracks current truth in both directions -- a definition change is an event, not a defect.

metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.meaning: How available/reachable a compute node currently is.
How much spare operating capacity a capability has right now.
Per-step verbosity of the FCC motor's tool output for one turn.
Athena cabinet ambient microphone activity (CMTECK USB RMS band deviation). Levels-only -- not speech content. Distinct from fan_pressure and thermal_pressure.
Whether Athena's ambient microphone snapshot is too stale to trust. When elevated, cabinet_ambient_audio_activity is withheld upstream -- this channel carries the liveness signal instead.
Athena cabinet climate sensor activity (BME680 temperature/humidity/pressure band deviation). Distinct from node thermal_pressure -- measures the enclosure ambient, not CPU/GPU die heat.
Athena cabinet electromagnetic activity (AD8313 RF power band deviation).
Athena cabinet particulate/air-quality sensor activity (PMS5003 band deviation).
Athena cabinet proximity/presence sensor activity (VL53L0X band deviation).
Whether Athena's cabinet Arduino sensor bundle is too stale to trust. When elevated, cabinet activity channels are withheld upstream -- this channel carries the liveness signal instead.
Athena cabinet UV sensor activity (GUVA-S12SD band deviation).
Athena cabinet vibration activity (MPU6050 accel deviation from 1g rest).
Drift/staleness in the bus event "catalog" (schema registry) relative to what's actually flowing.

Did the FCC motor actually produce a compliant, delivered turn -- HarnessRunV1.compliance_verdict rank (completed/partial/failed/refused), distinct from failure_pressure since a turn can resolve partial with zero individual tool-step failures.
How confident the system is that a given capability is currently reliable/available.

What fraction of one FCC-motor turn's classified tool calls were read-only research/context tools (Read, Grep, WebSearch, mcp__gitnexus__*, mcp__firecrawl__*, ...) vs action/mutation tools (Bash, Edit, Write, other MCP tools) -- composition, not volume (harness_step_load already covers volume). A fixed, deterministic tool-name allowlist, not a taxonomy: an unmatched tool name increments neither bucket, so 0.0 can mean either all-execution or zero-classified-calls.
Pressure from bus/schema "contract" mismatches (precise real-world condition not otherwise documented in code).
How much active conversational load (turn volume/complexity) is occurring.

Renamed from execution_load 2026-07-24 for scope honesty (the sibling of harness_step_load, cortex-exec-scoped instead of harness-governor-scoped) and lane-gated to exclude the harness_motor lane (whose cortex_exec_started_step_count is structurally always 0, since that counter only increments for orion-cortex-exec-sourced exec_step_started events) -- previously that always-0 harness_motor-lane reading stomped the real cortex-exec-lane value via mode="replace" on the shared node key. cortex-exec-only proxy for how much active execution work (agent runs, tool calls) is in flight on a node.
How loaded a node's CPU currently is.

Confidence that bus messages are actually being delivered end-to-end. Single-observer channel (2026-07-22): only node:athena's bus-observer ever reports this -- atlas/circe/prometheus have no code path that could produce a real reading and are excluded from the merge entirely (SINGLE_OBSERVER_NODE_CHANNELS, services/orion-field-digester/app/tensor/channels.py), not defaulted to a placeholder value.
How full a node's monitored filesystems are (percent used, max across configured mounts). Distinct from disk_pressure, which measures I/O throughput, not capacity.
Node disk I/O pressure.
1 - confidence that an execution's output actually reached its destination.
How much resistance (retries/backoff) execution is encountering on a node.
Capability-level execution-load pressure.
Signals a node is expected to be offline, so its absence shouldn't be read as a failure.
Recent execution failure rate/severity on a node.
Node BMC fan speed (percent of max, max across fans). A response to thermal load, not an independent hazard on its own -- 0.0 on a node without iLO/BMC credentials configured.
Per-node incoherence score -- fires when two reducers that should agree about a node's state disagree.
How loaded a node's GPU currently is.

FCC-motor-only step-load proxy for one unified Hub turn, split out of cortex_exec_step_load (renamed from execution_load 2026-07-24; blended cortex-exec + harness-governor step counts and hard-capped at 8 before the 2026-07-23 fix) -- a compute/thermal/power cost proxy for how much processing one turn actually cost on the expensive GPU node running the motor.
Node RAM pressure.
Pressure from failures of the bus "observer" role (monitoring/subscriber-side failures).
Node power-draw pressure. Real chassis-wide wattage (iLO/BMC RedFish) when that node has BMC credentials configured; falls back to a GPU-power-only estimate otherwise. 0.0 on a node with neither.
How much a recent prediction (from the prediction/surprise subsystem) missed reality.
Overall load/pressure for a given capability (llm_inference, orchestration, storage, graph, memory, transport, vision).

How much active LLM-reasoning work a node is doing. Real magnitude since 2026-07-24: cortex-exec-sourced runs use reasoning_char_count (chars); harness-motor-sourced runs use reasoning_output_tokens (real provider-computed tokens from the FCC CLI's own result-event usage object, confirmed live). Falls back to a 0.35/0.05 presence-only flag only when neither magnitude is set.
Capability-level reasoning-load pressure.
Capability-level pressure representing risk to reliability (from execution friction, failures, or observer failures).
How much conversational "repair" (corrections, re-explaining) is happening in chat.
Whether a node's most recent biometrics sample is too old to trust.

Renamed from bus_health 2026-07-24, same scope-honesty reasoning as stream_backlog_pressure above -- reflects world_pulse's one Redis Stream, not overall bus/transport subsystem health. Single-observer channel (2026-07-22): only node:athena's bus-observer ever reports this -- atlas/circe/prometheus have no code path that could produce a real reading and are excluded from the merge entirely (SINGLE_OBSERVER_NODE_CHANNELS, services/orion-field-digester/app/tensor/channels.py), not defaulted to a placeholder value.

Renamed from transport_pressure 2026-07-24 for scope honesty: this only ever measures world_pulse's one real Redis Stream (orion:stream:world_pulse:run:result) and its dead-letter queue -- the only thing in the architecture with a real backlog/XLEN concept. Everything else on the bus is Pub/Sub, which has no backlog to measure. Not a general bus/transport-layer pressure signal, and not intended to become one without a genuinely different mechanism -- see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-22-transport-bus-signal-quality-measurement-design.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-23-transport-domain-rpc-health-redesign.md for the real cross-service RPC-health signal being built separately.

DERIVED (not a raw pre-merge channel): this IS the PRESSURE_DIMENSIONS 'deviation_pressure' value itself, not a channel that feeds it. This tick's admitted field-deviation tension, in [0, 1]. 0.0 is the expected reading once the producer has been running a while ('nothing admitted' is a real, common state) -- but a row from before the producer existed also reads 0.0 (schema default), indistinguishable in storage. Read verdicts from a window entirely after deploy.
Node thermal/temperature pressure.
Is the FCC motor stuck repeating the same tool failure (e.g. a denied permission) instead of adapting, for one turn.

Did Hub fail to get a usable result back from the harness-governor RPC for this turn at all -- the one unified-turn failure mode where no governor-side grammar event exists. A distinct, worse severity than compliance_deficit's worst rank.
